item.title: Wicket 0.9.9
item.description:
## Clearer selection and cards
- **The selected row is easy to see on any background.** It was too faint over dark wallpapers and windows in 0.9.8, and also on the light glass. It now has a clear contrast in both modes, in the main list and on pages. - **Cards and tiles stay visible over dark backgrounds.** In dark mode they're a light fill with a clear edge instead of a darker well that disappeared over a dark backdrop.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.8
item.description:
## Cleaner glass
- **Cards, tiles and selection fit the glass.** Boxes on pages now use more of the glass's own tint, so the wallpaper's colours show through them instead of turning grey. The selected row looks the same in the main list and on pages. - **Calmer colours.** The glass boosts the wallpaper's colours less, in both light and dark. - **Simpler sliders.** Settings ▸ General ▸ Transparency and Blur now move in even steps that snap into place. Transparency is how much of the desktop shows through (default 30%). Blur is how soft it gets (default 1, like the desktop widgets). Both sliders start from their new defaults, because the old positions meant something different.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.7
item.description:
## Glass that matches macOS
- **Like your desktop widgets.** Wicket's glass now looks like the widgets on your desktop: the wallpaper's colours stay rich instead of turning grey, with the same soft lens effect. Dark mode is a dark tint, light mode a light one for dark text, with the same look in both. - **The sliders still work, with a new middle.** Settings ▸ General ▸ Transparency and Blur now have the new look in the middle, which is the new default. Drag left for a more solid or sharper panel, right for clearer or softer glass. If you changed these sliders before, your values carry over but look different now. Put both sliders in the middle to get the new look.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.6
item.description:
## Easier to read over any wallpaper
- **Solid text on the glass.** Text you type and the main text in results, pages and answers is now solid black or white instead of slightly translucent, so a busy or bright wallpaper no longer shows through the letters. Secondary text is darker too. - Page rows keep the same grey as the result list when Increase Contrast is on.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.5
item.description:
## Calendar
- **Your next 7 days in Wicket.** Type `calendar` for an agenda under Today, Tomorrow and dated headings, with the next event or the call on now at the top. Search by title, place or calendar. - **Join calls with Return.** When a Meet, Zoom, Teams or Webex call is on or starts within 10 minutes, Return joins it; otherwise Return opens Calendar.app. - **Ask about your schedule.** The agent can read your agenda to answer questions like "when am I free on Thursday?". Invitation notes are treated as data, never as instructions. - Hide calendars or all-day events in Settings. Wicket asks for Calendar access the first time you open it, never while you type.
## Caffeinate
- **Keep your Mac awake.** Type `caff`, Tab, and a number of hours (with optional minutes and seconds), or press Return to stay awake until you turn it off. The timer keeps running when Wicket closes.
## Extension versions
- Built-in extensions now carry a version. If you changed a built-in and it falls behind, Settings shows "Based on 1.0.0 · Built-in is 1.1.0", and **Ask Agent to Merge** tells the agent which original your copy started from so it can keep your changes and the new fixes. It also works when an update breaks your copy. - A modified Quicklinks copy keeps its site icons.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.4
item.description:
## Charts that look at home
- **Native colours.** Charts start with your macOS accent colour and continue with Apple's system colours, skipping the one closest to your accent so no two series look alike. They follow light and dark mode. - **No more empty space under bar charts.** Bar and share charts are as tall as their rows (up to a limit, then they scroll), and a long chart no longer clips its title. - **Shorter answers.** The agent answers what you asked and offers related facts as a row instead of adding them to the answer.
## Icons for extensions and Quicklinks
- **Quicklinks shows each site's icon.** The first time you open a link or search, Wicket fetches that site's favicon from the site itself and uses it from then on; until then you see a globe. - **Extensions can use their own images.** An extension's `icon` can now be a PNG or SVG file in its folder as well as an SF Symbol.
## Also
- **Convert understands spelled-out units:** `5 km in miles`, `10 pounds in kg`, `20 celsius in fahrenheit`. - Calculator and Convert format large numbers with your region's digit grouping, including lakh-style grouping. - Voice records a little more detail in the system log, still only formats and timings, so microphone problems are quicker to diagnose. - Fixes: an agent error message containing non-English characters could come out garbled.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.3
item.description:
## Dictation that starts reliably
- **USB microphones no longer fail with "Couldn't convert microphone audio."** Webcam and USB mics could fail right after Wicket opened, roughly every other time. Voice now follows the format change macOS makes when the microphone starts, and keeps the first syllable. - **No false "No sound" errors.** Microphones with noise suppression or a noise gate stay silent until you speak, and Wicket no longer stops them after a second. "No sound from …" now appears only if the microphone stayed completely silent until listening ended. - **The listening window starts when audio actually arrives,** so a slow speech-model start no longer cuts you off before you've begun. - Voice attempts now leave a clearer trace in the system log to make future microphone problems quicker to diagnose. It records formats and timings only, never what you said.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.2
item.description:
## A calmer agent while it works
The spinner and the "Connecting…", "Thinking…" and tool lines are gone. While the agent works, a slim light in your accent colour sweeps along the divider above the footer, dims a little once the answer starts streaming, and fades when it's done. A cancelled turn ends with a brief grey stop. After three seconds, the elapsed time appears in the footer's left corner. With Reduce Motion the light stays in place and pulses, and VoiceOver still reads what the agent is doing.
## Also
- **Return to search after** in Settings ▸ Agent sets how long an idle conversation stays when you hide Wicket: Immediately, 30 s, 1 min (default), 3 min, 5 min, 10 min, 15 min or Never. - Run **Left Half** or **Right Half** again to cycle the window through half, two-thirds and one-third width. **Restore** undoes the whole cycle in one step. - Rows can copy a whole draft: Return on a "Copy draft" row copies the text inside it, once the answer has finished. - The microphone works for dictation even with **Listen when Wicket opens** turned off. - Long input stays on one line and scrolls sideways instead of wrapping. - Fixes: undo after a multi-line paste no longer removes your earlier typing, a failed dictation no longer leaves its error on every later open, and opening a page from a list no longer flashes the previous detail.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.1
item.description:
## Better file search
- Files from your Desktop, Documents, Downloads, iCloud Drive and cloud storage are searched on their own, so they are no longer crowded out by the many matches inside source code and other folders. - More build and dependency folders are skipped, such as `dist`, `target`, `vendor`, `venv` and `site-packages`. - Among equally good matches, files you used or added recently come first, then shorter names.

item.title: Wicket 0.9.0
item.description:
## Charts
Answers can now draw charts. Ask the agent about a trend or a comparison and it shows lines, areas, columns, bars or a parts-of-a-whole bar instead of a wall of numbers, with thresholds and event markers where they help. Stacked columns, several series with a legend, and a highlighted highest or lowest value are all built in.
Extensions can use the same charts on their pages, and `theme.css` can restyle them through the new `--chart-*` tokens.
## Also
- Longer text fits in one row or tile: a tag can now hold 4,096 bytes instead of 1,024, so longer drafts keep their copy row. - While an answer streams, text after a `<` (as in `x<y`) no longer waits to appear.

item.title: Wicket 0.8.0
item.description:
## Your own window positions
Windows lets you add your own moves in Settings: pick an anchor, a width and a height in percent, and give it a hotkey. Save Current Window turns the window in front into a move. The agent can add them too.
## Smoother everyday use
- Voice works with the lid closed on a dock, skips silent microphones, and tells you when it hears nothing. - Shell runs your aliases and opens commands in the terminal you pick (only installed ones are listed). - Calculator and Convert answer right as you type, with no page to open. Currency is instant and keeps working offline with the last known rate. Pick their decimal places from a menu. - Weather opens your default city right away. - Search finds apps and items with words in any order, like "code visual". - After a minute away, Wicket opens fresh at search instead of the last page. - Clipboard and Windows have shorter names, and Settings has a slimmer sidebar.
## Fixes
- Hotkeys behave the same in Settings, diagnostics and when pressed; swapping two keys works. - Moving one of your extensions to the Trash keeps its hotkeys and settings for when you restore it. - Settings you change are stored as overrides, so extension updates bring new defaults for everything you didn't touch.

item.title: Wicket 0.7.8
item.description:
## Answers that look like an app
The built-in agent now lays out answers the way you'd expect from a small Mac app, based on layouts picked by hand:
- Two options sit side by side: a comparison as two cards, a recommendation as two tiles with the pick marked. - Things to grab, like a packing list, show as an icon grid with one row to copy the list. - Steps and explanations are numbered rows or points; press Return on one for the details. - Statuses show a badge and one bar per state. - Written text, like a note or an email, sits in a card with a row to copy it, or as two versions side by side when the tone is up to you.

item.title: Wicket 0.7.7
item.description:
## Your lists in Settings
- Quicklinks bookmarks and site searches now live in Settings ▸ Extensions ▸ Quicklinks. Add, edit and delete them there, and give any of them a hotkey. - Your existing entries move over automatically the first time you open the new version. - Window Manager: "Save Current Window…" saves the current window's position as a named move you can run by keyword or hotkey.

item.title: Wicket 0.7.6
item.description:
## Weather while you type
- Type `weather` and a city: the current weather appears as you type, from the fourth letter. Results are remembered for 10 minutes, so typing on or going back doesn't ask again. - Press Return for the new forecast page: the next 12 hours in 2-hour steps and the next 5 days, all in one view without scrolling.

item.title: Wicket 0.7.5
item.description:
## Better with Bluetooth headphones
- Voice no longer switches your Bluetooth headphones into low-quality call mode. Wicket prefers your Mac's own or any wired microphone. - If your headphones are the only microphone, voice doesn't start on its own; click the mic to use them. - Wicket fully releases the microphone when voice stops, so music returns to full quality.
## Weather
- Type `weather Berlin` and press Return for current conditions and the forecast, from Open-Meteo. Set a default city and °C or °F in Settings ▸ Extensions ▸ Weather.

item.title: Wicket 0.7.4
item.description:
### What's changed
- **Voice input on Bluetooth headsets:** Fixed microphone capture failing (`conversionFailed`) on 16 kHz mono Bluetooth inputs such as AirPods over HFP by accepting native PCM formats. - **Better app vs. folder ranking:** Typing a prefix like `chat` now keeps matching apps like ChatGPT above unused local folders named `chat` (while folders you pick can still rise with usage). - **Simpler, faster Convert:** Currency conversions now load live rates directly from the Frankfurter API as you type—no manual download prompt. Conversions default to 2 decimal places, show "Copy value", and copy just the number by default (both decimal precision and including the unit are configurable in Settings). - **Quicklinks replaces Search the Web & Links & Search:** Removed the separate Search the Web extension and replaced hard-coded starter links with a clean Quicklinks extension driven by your own bookmarks, `{query}` search URLs, keywords, and hotkeys.

item.title: Wicket 0.7.3
item.description:
## Wicket can diagnose itself
- Ask Wicket's agent why something doesn't work (an extension, a shortcut, a permission, voice). It now runs `Wicket --diagnose` first and answers from facts. - The report shows Wicket's version and signature, permissions as Wicket sees them, every extension (built-in, yours, or yours replacing a built-in; problems; missing permissions), and every shortcut with whether it works or why not. - Wicket keeps a small private record of the last 10 extension failures and the last voice failure, so they're still there after you close the panel. It never contains what you type, clipboard contents, transcripts or conversations.

item.title: Wicket 0.7.2
item.description:
## Updates inside Wicket
- When an update is available, opening Wicket with nothing typed shows **Update Wicket to …**. Press Return to see what's new and install, or choose ⌘K ▸ Dismiss to hide it until Wicket restarts. - The menu-bar icon shows a dot and its menu offers **Update to …** while an update waits. - Wicket now checks for updates every 6 hours instead of once a day.
## Permission requests where they belong
- Permission requests no longer appear on the empty launcher. They show when you use the extension that needs them. - A shortcut whose extension can't be found now shows its own problem, not another extension's permission request. - The Accessibility request now says which extension needs it and what to do if the switch already looks on.
